title: Lab 2A — VPC build
topic: Hands-on VPC: subnets, route tables, IGW, NAT, EIP, security groups
format: 10 timed scenario questions (~16 min, ~96 sec each). Reinforces what you just built in night-9-lab-vpc-build.sh. Answer without peeking at night-9-quiz-answers.json first.
answerDistribution: A×3 B×2 C×3 D×2 — options shuffled so correct letter varies

questions.question: You create a VPC and subnets named public-a and private-a, but instances in public-a still cannot reach the internet. DNS resolves but ping to 8.8.8.8 fails. The subnet has map-public-ip-on-launch enabled. What is the most likely missing step?

options.A: Attach an IGW and add 0.0.0.0/0 → IGW on the public route table
options.B: Enable VPC Flow Logs on the public subnet for packet capture
options.C: Add a NAT Gateway route on the public subnet's route table too
options.D: Change the NACL to allow ICMP echo requests plus echo replies

questions.question: A NAT Gateway sits in a public subnet; private subnet route tables point 0.0.0.0/0 to that NAT. Why must the NAT sit in a public subnet rather than a private one?

options.A: NAT Gateways are billed only when placed inside public subnets
options.B: Private subnets cannot attach Elastic IPs to any VPC resource
options.C: The NAT needs an IGW route in its subnet to reach the internet
options.D: AWS requires NAT Gateways to share the private subnet CIDR range

questions.question: Both public subnets share one route table with 0.0.0.0/0 → IGW. Private subnets share a second route table with 0.0.0.0/0 → a single NAT in AZ-a. What happens if AZ-a becomes unavailable?

options.A: AWS automatically fails over the NAT into the public-b subnet
options.B: The IGW redirects NAT traffic into healthy AZ-b automatically
options.C: Private subnets fail over to the public route table with the IGW
options.D: Private workloads lose outbound internet until NAT is restored per AZ

questions.question: Before creating a NAT Gateway you allocate an Elastic IP with --domain vpc. What happens if you skip the Elastic IP and try to create the NAT with only a private IP?

options.A: NAT Gateway creation fails — a VPC Elastic IP allocation is required
options.B: NAT works but only for traffic destined within the VPC CIDR block
options.C: AWS auto-assigns a public IP from the subnet pool at no extra charge
options.D: NAT reuses the Internet Gateway public IP address for outbound SNAT

questions.question: A VPC has enable-dns-hostnames and enable-dns-support turned on. A Fargate task in a private subnet must reach the regional ECR endpoint hostname. Which statement is correct?

options.A: DNS hostnames are irrelevant — hard-code IPs in the task definition
options.B: Private subnets cannot resolve public AWS service DNS names at all
options.C: DNS resolves AWS names; private subnets still need NAT or endpoints
options.D: Enabling DNS hostnames auto-creates interface endpoints for all APIs

questions.question: A Fargate task security group allows egress TCP 443 to 0.0.0.0/0 and has no inbound rules. The task must pull from ECR and write to S3 from a private subnet. What is the first networking check if the task fails to start?

options.A: Add inbound 443 from 0.0.0.0/0 on the Fargate task security group
options.B: Confirm private subnet egress via NAT or ECR/S3 endpoints plus role
options.C: Move the task to a public subnet and disable the security group
options.D: Attach an Internet Gateway directly to the private subnet route table

questions.question: A colleague associates a new private subnet with the main (default) route table, which only has the local VPC CIDR route. Fargate tasks in that subnet cannot reach the internet. What fix matches the intended private-subnet pattern?

options.A: Associate the subnet with the private route table (0.0.0.0/0 → NAT)
options.B: Rename the subnet so the name includes private- for AWS routing
options.C: Enable map-public-ip-on-launch so tasks receive public IP addresses
options.D: Add an Internet Gateway default route only on the main route table

questions.question: You want to reduce NAT data-processing charges for large S3 uploads from private subnets. Which addition keeps S3 traffic off the NAT?

options.A: Second NAT Gateway in another Availability Zone for HA capacity
options.B: S3 gateway VPC endpoint associated with the private route table
options.C: Internet Gateway route added to the private subnet route table
options.D: Bastion host in the public subnet proxying S3 PutObject API calls

questions.question: You launch an ECS Fargate task with assignPublicIp DISABLED in private subnets. What does DISABLED imply for networking?

options.A: The task cannot communicate with other resources inside the VPC
options.B: ECS automatically creates a Site-to-Site VPN for the task ENI
options.C: The task is rejected unless the subnet has an Internet Gateway route
options.D: No public IPv4 on the ENI — outbound uses NAT or VPC endpoints

questions.question: For ecs:RunTask with awsvpc networking in private subnets, which pair must you supply in networkConfiguration?

options.A: VPC ID and Internet Gateway ID for the public outbound route path
options.B: NAT Gateway ID and Elastic IP allocation ID used for SNAT mapping
options.C: Private subnet IDs and the task security group ID for awsvpc
options.D: Public subnet IDs and the public route table ID for the task ENI
